rows.source_statement: Unresolvable contradiction either births a new axis or leads to collapse.
rows.formal_proposition: For every StressContext, classify returns absorption, extension, collapse, or underdetermined; same-description repair proves absorption and repairs the old fork.
rows.assumptions: StressContext declares evidenceBound, sameDescriptionRepair, extensionRepair, and invariantFailure.
rows.proof_or_counterproof: Lean center_four_outcome_total proves totality; center_absorption_repairs_old_fork proves the old two-outcome fork was incomplete.
rows.falsifier_check: A same-description repair falsifies the old fork but not the four-outcome theorem.
rows.dependency_closure: Depends on 029 central theorem and 027/028 repair guard.

rows.source_statement: OC adequacy roles are not eliminable.
rows.formal_proposition: For every missing AdequacyRole, missingRoleLanguage missing is not Adequate.
rows.assumptions: AdequacyRole enumerates observation coverage, distinguishability, dynamics, pressure, repair, extension, collapse, underdetermination, projection non-inflation, evidence binding, and refinement.
rows.proof_or_counterproof: Lean adequacy_no_role_eliminable and Python role-removal witnesses prove the lower bound.
rows.falsifier_check: A falsifier would remove a role while preserving Adequate; Lean reduces this to r != r.

rows.source_statement: Six continuum operators are independent and minimal under typed semantic effect signatures.
rows.formal_proposition: OperatorAdequate requires introduce, differentiate, stabilize, project, invalidate, and repair; removing any operator role breaks adequacy and operatorCode is injective.
rows.assumptions: Operator roles are typed semantic effects, not arbitrary names.
rows.proof_or_counterproof: Lean operatorCode_injective and operators_no_role_eliminable prove role separation and lower bound.
rows.falsifier_check: A generic rewrite operator does not falsify typed-role minimality because it is not role-preserving over the six effects.

rows.source_statement: K-levels are a parametric rank/closure ladder with adjacent non-collapse.
rows.formal_proposition: kRank n < kRank (n+1), and kLadder maxDepth is List.range (maxDepth+1).
rows.assumptions: K-level proof is relative to rank/closure parameter maxDepth.
rows.proof_or_counterproof: Lean k_adjacent_noncollapse and k_reference_depth_12_count prove ladder and reference count.
rows.falsifier_check: Adjacent collapse is blocked by Nat.lt_succ_self.
rows.dependency_closure: Depends on 029 parametric K theorem and source K nodes.

rows.source_statement: K0-K12 is the absolute unique cosmic count.
rows.formal_proposition: There exists an alternative kLadder depth with length not equal to 13; therefore absolute count is not derivable without depth parameter.
rows.assumptions: K0-K12 remains a reference instantiation at depth 12.
rows.proof_or_counterproof: Lean k_absolute_count_guard and Python len(k_ladder(13)) != 13 prove the guard.
rows.falsifier_check: A stronger proof would need a canonical depth theorem absent from current core.
rows.dependency_closure: Depends on OC30-K-001 and 029 K repair.

rows.source_statement: Internal OC theorem schemas require closed dependencies, proof artifact, and falsifier.
rows.assumptions: A theorem schema is admissible only with dependenciesClosed, proofArtifact, and falsifier.
rows.falsifier_check: A schema with open dependencies is not admissible.
rows.verification_note: Validator requires proof fields on every row.

rows.source_statement: Law-like OC statements require trigger, scope, outcome criterion, and falsifier.
rows.assumptions: A law candidate must name trigger, scope, outcomeCriterion, and falsifier.
rows.proof_or_counterproof: Lean law_requires_falsifier proves non-rhetorical law admission.
rows.falsifier_check: A law without falsifier fails LawAdmissible.
rows.verification_note: Article boundary forbids laws without falsifiers.

rows.source_statement: Crown stones are proved by the core alone.
rows.formal_proposition: coreOnlyDomainProjection has coreSignature but no local evidence; CrownPromoted coreOnlyDomainProjection is false.
rows.assumptions: A crown stone needs a theorem chain or local evidence package beyond core signature.
rows.proof_or_counterproof: Lean crown_not_core_without_local_evidence proves rejection from core alone.
rows.falsifier_check: A falsifier would promote coreOnlyDomainProjection despite missing local evidence.
rows.verification_note: Article boundary forbids crown promotion from core alone.

rows.source_statement: Domain projection discipline requires local evidence.
rows.assumptions: LocalEvidenceComplete requires observables, constraints, operators, invariants, falsifiers, and evidenceBindings.
rows.proof_or_counterproof: Lean domain_projection_requires_local_evidence and core_signature_alone_not_domain_proof prove non-inflation.
rows.falsifier_check: Core signature alone does not validate a domain projection.
rows.verification_note: lake build checks domain projection lemmas.

rows.source_statement: Biology source-domain replay validates the domain projection as a real-domain theorem.
rows.formal_proposition: Biology requires a 030 local evidence package with observables, constraints, operators, invariants, falsifiers, and evidence bindings before it may be marked DOMAIN_PROJECTION_PROVED_WITH_LOCAL_EVIDENCE.
rows.assumptions: The 022 source graph has replay/source labels, but 030 does not treat replay labels as complete empirical local evidence.
rows.proof_or_counterproof: Lean domain_projection_requires_local_evidence proves the local-evidence gate; Python records the source-domain queue.
rows.falsifier_check: A falsifier would provide complete local evidence and then this row would be reopened as a proved domain projection, not promoted from vocabulary alone.
rows.dependency_closure: Depends on OC30-DOMAIN-DISCIPLINE-001 and source graph domain nodes.
rows.verification_note: Python witness lists the five source domains and validator blocks proved-domain status without local_evidence_package=1.

rows.source_statement: 030 must bind source graph root, K nodes, operators, and domains without treating source-bound labels as proof.
rows.formal_proposition: The source graph is used as source statement inventory; formal proof authority is 030 Lean/Python/DB.
rows.assumptions: Source graph root is the old two-outcome fork, K nodes are definitional/source-bound, operators are source-bound, and domains are replay-labelled.
rows.proof_or_counterproof: 030 source binding records those surfaces and routes them through repaired formal contours.
rows.falsifier_check: A source-bound label alone is not allowed to satisfy proof-grade fields.
rows.dependency_closure: Depends on source graph inspection and all previous contours.
rows.verification_note: Validator requires artifact refs and proof bodies for every row.

rows.source_statement: Article wording must be generated only from rows whose dependencies are closed and whose status allows promotion.
rows.formal_proposition: Article-positive claims require promotion-eligible status; domain-instantiation rows produce boundary language only.
rows.assumptions: Promotion statuses are constrained by validate_030.py and article boundary.
rows.proof_or_counterproof: Validator checks bad promotion rows and forbidden promoted wording.
rows.falsifier_check: A forbidden promoted phrase fails validation.

rows.source_statement: The concentric proof graph has no open contour rows.
rows.formal_proposition: All 17 contour rows have allowed terminal status and required proof fields.
rows.assumptions: Closeout requires Lean build, witnesses, validator, and regression validators.
rows.proof_or_counterproof: validate_030.py checks total row count, statuses, artifacts, fields, promotions, local evidence, and control row.
rows.falsifier_check: A missing artifact, open row, bad promotion, or disallowed status fails closeout.
rows.dependency_closure: Depends on all 030 rows and regression checks.
